text: Respond to your child’s crying within seconds—not as indulgence, but as building their neurological security. Research confirms: swift response = a calm brain, high confidence, better learning. Ignoring = chronic stress.

review_defects.why: The Arabic 'أمانه' means 'his security/safety', not 'amanah' (trust). The translator misread the word and introduced an Islamic term not present in the source, changing the meaning from 'neurological security' to 'neurological trust'.
